principle: Use environment, psychology and relationship factors as evidence-conditioned context. Do not apply universal fixed goal, probability or grade penalties without calibration.

heat_humidity.rule: High heat/humidity may reduce high-intensity output and alter pacing, especially for non-acclimatized teams. Prefer WBGT/heat-stress context when available.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not multiply expected goals by a universal (1-Debuff) factor.
Do not automatically downgrade one grade because conditions are hot/humid.

altitude.rule: Altitude, especially around 2000m+ and for low-altitude/non-acclimatized visitors, can reduce running/high-intensity output and affect recovery and ball flight. Review actual venue altitude, days since arrival and acclimatization history.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not hard-code second-half attack x0.7.
Do not use universal 3-day/7-day multipliers without validation.

rain_wind.rule: Heavy rain, standing water, strong wind/gusts and poor drainage can alter ball speed, passing, crossing, long balls, goalkeeper handling, footing, set-piece value and error rates. Direction of total goals is not predetermined.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not assign universal -0.5/-1.0/-1.5 expected-goal penalties by rain category.
Do not assume heavy rain always means Under.

travel_circadian.rule: For transmeridian/long-haul travel, consider body-clock mismatch, number/direction of time zones, arrival time, sleep/recovery opportunity and whether the trip is national-team-to-club or club travel.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not hard-code morning=-0.3, afternoon=-0.2, late-night=-0.5 or any universal kickoff penalty.
Do not treat local kickoff time alone as circadian evidence without travel/body-clock context.

home_geography.rule: Home crowd, geography, altitude/climate familiarity and local adaptation may matter, but only as residual context beyond the model's existing home-field baseline.

long_rest.rule: Rest >=6 days is not automatically an attacking penalty. Review training rhythm, return from break, squad rotation and match context instead.

general.rule: Narrative/psychology factors must have identifiable evidence and a plausible mechanism. They cannot receive a universal grade penalty/bonus.

two_leg_ties.rule: Use aggregate score, qualification incentives, competition rules, home/away leg, remaining time and opponent style to infer game state. A first-leg lead >=2 does not mechanically imply relaxation, and a trailing team does not mechanically become a good bet.

manager_change_morale.rule: New manager, morale rebound, complacency or emotional letdown may be considered only with supporting squad/club evidence and price confirmation. Guard against regression-to-the-mean and post-hoc storytelling.

national_team_chemistry.rule: Review continuity, shared-club/cohort familiarity, training time, coach tenure and lineup turnover for national teams. Shared origin can support coordination, but fixed player-count thresholds are not calibrated.

club_relationship_network.rule: Review ownership/multi-club groups, management/coaching/agent networks, loans/transfers, academy/satellite relationships, local business/political ties, historic friendly/hostile ties and table incentives. Keep verified facts separate from reciprocity hypotheses.
forbidden_shortcuts: No S/A/B bond tier automatic +1.0/+0.5/+0.3 adjustment.
No relationship narrative can override Titan market evidence by itself.

host_face_bilateral_narrative.rule: For national-team/host events, etiquette, host-face, bilateral or ceremonial narratives may be logged only when there is concrete public evidence; otherwise label as unverified and do not use as a formal weight.

tactical_countermatch.rule: Tactical style-counter relationships belong in Lineup/Tactics. Opaque V1/V2/V3/V4 fixed counter weights are not accepted into MODEL_1 without definition and validation.
